decision.summary: The oven is out of warranty by the contractor's account, and Harbour Services have quoted £150 by phone. The landlord only asked for a free warranty service, so I recorded the quote, asked him to approve the spend, told the contractor not to start paid work, updated the tenant and held the job until 6 June.
